component.name: Proton Stream
component.summary: Stream the videos in your Proton Drive as a library

description.p: A library for the videos in your Proton Drive and in the share links people send you. Paste a share link, with its password if it has one, or sign in and pick folders of your Drive. Episodes start in seconds and seeking fetches only what it lands on: nothing is downloaded first.
This is an unofficial, community-built client, not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG. It provides no content: it plays what you keep in Proton Drive or what is shared with you.

ul.li: Any number of share links and Drive folders merged into one library
Seasons and episodes from folder and file names; a file without numbers is a film
Optional posters, synopses and shelves from AniList, TMDB and TVmaze, off by default
Playback through libmpv: HEVC 10-bit, HDR and ASS subtitles with hardware decoding
Skip the opening and the ending, an up-next countdown and remembered track choices
Resume on any device: watch history, shares and settings sync through your own Drive
Downloads of an episode, a season or a show, to play offline
Full keyboard control, and the pstr command line

description.p: There is no server and no telemetry. Share keys, link passwords and your Proton session are kept in the system keyring, never in a config file.

screenshot.caption: Home, with the hero carousel and shelves
The whole library, filtered and sorted
A title page with its seasons and episodes

description.p: Folders from your own Proton Drive pick up new episodes within minutes: the app checks Drive for changes while it is open instead of waiting six hours.

ul.li: Android runs on 32-bit Android TVs and boxes.
4K playback on Windows uses the discrete GPU and buffers more, so it no longer stutters.
Signing out while a session refresh is in flight no longer signs you back in.

description.p: A new logo and app icon.

ul.li: A full-bleed hero carousel, title logos, quality badges and paged shelves
My List, synced, with new-episode rows and badges
Search across episodes and people; browse by genre, studio and person
Cast, trailers and more-like-this on the title page
Opening and ending skips from AniSkip where a file has no chapters
A player side panel, a seek overlay and a pause screen
TVmaze for shows AniList does not have, and film artwork from TMDB
